jobs.title: Senior  Test Software Developer
jobs.description:
OUR STORY

At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.

When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.

Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.

Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.

YOUR ROLE

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented engineering professional to join our Test R&D Software Solution team within the Global Technology R&D organization. You will be responsible for developing automation and robotics solutions, overseeing the development of all software applications. You will work in an international, multidisciplinary, and multicultural environment, interacting with factories, IT, product groups, quality, finance, suppliers, and executive management.

Key Responsibilities

You will be contributing to implementing ST's vision and roadmap towards Industry 4.0 with below key responsibilities:

Analyzing processes to automate them using standard technology bricks
Developing prototypes and software solutions internally or through external suppliers
Conducting technical and economic benchmarks between different software solutions
Building and coordinating software development projects, evaluating their costs, benefits, risks, and issues
Reporting the project status to executive managers

Your Skills & Experiences

Master's degree in computer engineering, electronic engineering, computer science
Excellent knowledge of the English language, both written and spoken
At least five years of experience in the industrial automation sector, preferably in the semiconductor sector
Knowledge of C#, C++ languages and solid foundations in object-oriented programming
Knowledge of Java
Knowledge of Python
Knowledge of Git and versioning in general
Knowledge of databases and SQL, SQLite languages
Knowledge of XML and XSD formats

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance.

At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.

To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

jobs.title: .NET Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Summary:

As an experienced .NET Software Engineer, you will play a key role in driving the success of our Supply Chain Management (SCM) applications and the technical development and scaling of our core enterprise systems. Operating within a modern .NET ecosystem, you will actively contribute to the end-to-end software development lifecycle (SDLC), driving the design, enablement and implementation of high-performance product features. In this role, you will combine strong hands-on technical execution with team collaboration, helping to establish engineering best practices, designing robust APIs and ensuring overall software excellence.

Detailed Description:

Full professional level; applies software engineering expertise in a specific area of specialization. Work is performed within established professional standards, technical guidelines and project objectives. Works on problems of moderate to diverse scope where analysis of technical requirements, system architectures and data schemas requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Exercises technical judgment within defined procedures and software development practices to determine appropriate action. Receives general instructions on routine development tasks and detailed instructions on new projects or complex system assignments. Builds productive collaborative relationships across development, QA and business analyst teams.
Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following:
● Contribute significantly to the architecture, design and end-to-end delivery of scalable enterprise web applications using ASP.NET Core MVC and .NET 10.
● Play a key role in the new features enablement process, designing and building brand-new product capabilities from scratch to deliver strategic business value.
● Establish robust architectural foundations, design RESTful APIs and optimize data flows integrated with Oracle DB.
● Deliver clean, maintainable and scalable code by strictly adhering to SOLID principles and Clean Code practices.
● Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement and retrospectives to ensure consistent sprint delivery and alignment.
● Manage modern development workflows in GitLab, utilizing standardized branching strategies, merge request processes and CI/CD practices.
● Collaborate closely with team members, sharing technical knowledge on modern .NET design patterns, coding standards and development best practices.
● Ensure application reliability and stability by defining and implementing code testing standards, structured debugging and proactive performance optimization.
● Proactively identify and resolve technical debt, modernize user interfaces and enhance application stability, security and performance.
● Collaborate with IT/Business partners, cross-functional teams and stakeholders to translate business requirements into clear technical specifications.
● Maintain comprehensive technical documentation for architectural designs, system configurations and database schemas to ensure long-term maintainability.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies:

● Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in the .NET ecosystem, with a strong passion for modern C# features and ASP.NET Core.
● Solid expertise in software design and architecture (Dependency Injection, Repository Pattern, Clean Architecture and Modular Design).
● Advanced proficiency in Database Architecture and SQL, with experience optimizing Entity Framework Core integrated with Oracle DB (experience with other relational databases such as PostgreSQL or SQL Server is highly acceptable).
● Competency in web development and frontend integration, combining ASP.NET Core MVC with JavaScript to build highly interactive, responsive and performant user interfaces using UI components (such as Telerik UI), along with basic HTML and CSS skills.
● Hands-on experience with version control and modern Git workflows (GitLab, branch protection, Merge Requests) along with exposure to CI/CD automation pipelines.
● Proven ability to work independently, take technical ownership of features, manage priorities and drive high quality standards through constructive code reviews.
● Flexibility to occasionally participate in technical discussions, business requirements alignment and specifications review with managers, architects and stakeholders in the Canada timezone (EST).
● Exceptional verbal and written English skills for cross-cultural collaboration, negotiating technical requirements and explaining complex .NET concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
● Self-driven, proactive mindset with a focus on writing highly scalable, long-term maintainable code and a desire to contribute to architectural discussions.
● Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment with a solid understanding of sprint cycles, collaborative delivery and continuous improvement is preferred.
● Understanding of Supply Chain Management (SCM) processes or ERP workflows is considered a strong asset (openness and willingness to learn these business processes is highly valued).
● Knowledge or experience with UI frameworks (e.g., Telerik UI for ASP.NET Core with Ajax Binding, Tag Helpers) is a strong asset.
● Prior knowledge of Java or Java ADF is not required, though any basic familiarity with these technologies is a welcome asset.
● Openness to utilizing modern development tools and AI-assisted engineering practices is preferred.

Physical Demands:

Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

Typical Experience:

5+ years of experience in a similar role spanning software development and .NET web applications delivery.

Typical Education:

University degree in one of the following: Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a related technical field.

Notes

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.

jobs.title: Fintech Software Entwickler (F#, C#, React)
jobs.description:
Wir definieren die Zukunft der finanziellen Vorsorge neu.

vlot ist ein in Zürich ansässiges SaaS-Unternehmen, das die Art und Weise verändert, wie finanzielle Absicherung und Vorsorge im B2B-Umfeld bereitgestellt werden.

Unsere Plattform übersetzt komplexe Finanz- und Pensionsdaten in klare, handlungsorientierte Empfehlungen – und ermöglicht es Versicherern, Banken, Brokern und Pensionskassen, ihren Kunden mehr Transparenz, Sicherheit und langfristige finanzielle Stabilität zu bieten.

Das Angebot kombiniert eine modulare SaaS-Plattform mit fachlicher Beratung, um ganzheitliche Financial-Wellbeing-Lösungen zu liefern – individuell, integriert, datenbasiert und stets im Einklang mit regulatorischen Anforderungen.

Gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern gestalten wir eine Zukunft, in der finanzielle Vorsorge nicht nur individuelle Sicherheit schafft, sondern auch die Resilienz der Gesellschaft stärkt.

Aufgaben

Software Entwicklung in Frontend und Backend

Mitgestalten der Architektur

Code Reviews und Wissenstransfer im Team

Automatisierung und DevOps mit Terraform auf Azure

Ideation und Feature Design mit unseren Finanzexperten und Kunden

Bugfixing, Entwicklung von Unit- und Integrationtests

UI/UX Entwicklung in Zusammenarbeit mit Designern

Mitarbeit und Verbesserungen an von uns eingesetzten Open Source Projekten

Qualifikation

Fundierte Ausbildung (FH, Uni oder HF) Richtung Informatik

Berufserfahrung in der Software Entwicklung

Tech ist deine Passion

Interesse an funktionalen Programmiersprachen

Idealerweise Mitarbeit in Open Source Projekten

Erfahrung mit Azure, Cloud-Automatisierung, SQL-Datenbanken vorteilhaft

Linux-Erfahrung von Vorteil (NixOS, Alpine, Ubuntu, ...)

Fliessend mündlich und schriftlich Deutsch und Englisch

Benefits

Wachse mit uns und gestalte die Zukunft von vlot!

Remote/Home Office (in der Schweiz)

Inspirierendes & motivierendes Umfeld - Lerne jeden Tag was Neues!

Direkter Austausch und enge Zusammenarbeit: Tech, Business & Strategie

Dynamisches InsurTech mit interdisziplinärem, erfahrenem Team

Teilnahme an spannenden Ideation Workshops bei/mit Kunden

Keine ausgeprägten Hierarchien - Jede Idee zählt, egal von wem

Flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie Teilzeitpensum möglich

Attraktive Entlöhnung mit mögl. Partizipation am Unternehmenserfolg

Gestalte die Zukunft der finanziellen Vorsorge mit vlot und bewirb dich als Fintech Software Entwickler - wir freuen uns darauf!

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description:
Luxclusif
is a technology-driven global B2B platform founded in 2013 and part of Farfetch since 2021. Dedicated to redefining the luxury paradigm by offering premium pre-owned fashion to a global audience, Luxclusif has pioneered the global luxury resale market, with advanced data-driven solutions to facilitate the buying and selling of high-end pre-owned items. With operations spread across the globe and strategic warehouses in key locations, ensure a seamless supply of luxury goods, ensuring item curation, quality control, operations, logistics to technology integrations and sales, delivering an unmatched resale experience for brands, retailers, and end-customers.

THE TEAM

Our R&D team is responsible for designing, developing, and evolving the internal products that power our business. As a B2B company specialising in second-hand luxury items, we rely on technology to optimise every stage of our operations, from buying and inbound logistics to selling and post-sales support. We are a global team with members across Portugal, Brazil, and the Philippines.

PORTO

Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals.

THE ROLE

As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you will join our Porto hub to develop internal products that power our business areas. You will pair with Product Managers, Designers, and other Engineers to define, plan, execute and foster a culture of technical excellence.

What You’ll Do

Be a Technical Reference: Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will drive architectural decisions for both backend services and frontend applications, establishing coding standards and best practices.
E2E Ownership: Own the definition, planning, execution, delivery, and monitoring of features in a production environment, ensuring high availability and performance.
Be Product-Driven: Pair with Product Managers on discovery, refinement, estimation, and prioritisation of new features, translating business requirements into technical specs.
Architect Scalable Solutions: Design and implement robust applications and event-driven architectures using Azure Service Bus and Hangfire for background processing and asynchronous tasks.
Ensure Data Integrity: Manage and optimise database schemas, ensuring data consistency and query performance.
Collaborate on UX/UI: Engage closely with the Design Team, ensuring faithful implementation of our web strategy and contribute to the evolution and maintenance of our internal Design System, ensuring visual consistency and code reusability.
Champion Documentation: Create and maintain clear documentation for APIs, architecture diagrams, and system flows.
Master the Stack: .NET (C#), SQL/MySQL/PostgreSQL, Hangfire, Azure Service Bus, React/TypeScript, Azure, Terraform, CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines).

Who You Are

Experienced: You have at least 7 years of experience building and deploying distributed systems and web applications.
Backend Specialist: You have deep proficiency in .NET (C#) and a solid grasp of Object-Oriented Programming and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
Database Proficient: You are comfortable working with relational databases and know how to optimise them for scale.
Async & Background Processing: You have proven experience implementing background jobs (using Hangfire or similar) and event-driven architecture using message brokers (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, Kafka, etc).
Frontend Capable: You are proficient with React and TypeScript, capable of building and maintaining functional and responsive UI components.
Quality Obsessed: You view automated testing (Unit, Integration) as a baseline for every feature and know how to integrate tests into a CI/CD pipeline.
Cloud Aware: Strong familiarity with Microsoft Azure and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) is highly valued.
Global Communicator: You are comfortable working with different time zones and thrive in an environment that values asynchronous communication and autonomy.

Rewards & Benefits

Health insurance for the whole family, flexible working environment and well-being support and tools
Extra days off, sabbatical program and days for you to give back for the community
Training opportunities and free access to Udemy
Flexible benefits program

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES STATEMENT

FARFETCH is committed to being an inclusive workplace where diversity in all its forms is celebrated. We make employment decisions without regard to race, religious creed, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, marital status, medical condition as defined by state law, physical or mental disability, military service or veteran status, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, genetic information or any other classification protected by applicable federal, state or local laws or ordinances. If you require special accommodation, please let us know.

SCAM DISCLAIMER

It has come to our attention that there may be fraudulent activities involving individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent Farfetch in order to attract candidates to a SCAM. Please be aware that Farfetch does not conduct recruitment processes through messaging apps or any unofficial communication channels, other than our official careers website. Additionally, Farfetch will never ask candidates for any form of payment during the recruitment process.
